summary: Mohawk Industries filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a new $1.5B unsecured revolving credit facility to refinance its existing credit agreement. The facility includes a $125M letter of credit sublimit, $150M swingline loans, and an accordion feature to increase commitments by up to $600M. Borrowings will be used to refinance, pay fees, and for general corporate purposes. The facility matures May 12, 2031, with optional extensions. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation event.
